slides.teacher_cue: New sound. Tongue tip touches the ridge just behind the upper teeth — same place as /n/ and /d/ — but air flows around both sides. Voice on. Mirror work mandatory: both /l/ and /r/ must be drilled and contrasted from this lesson onwards.
